title: The Coxeter transformation as an automorphism of the Tamarkin--Tsygan calculus
summary: Let $A$ be a finite-dimensional algebra over a field $\kk$. We show that the Auslander--Reiten bimodule $\ar_A:=\D A[-1]$ is central in the derived Picard group of $A$ and that, when $\gldim A<\infty$, it induces through the derived-invariance functor $\HB$ of \cite{Armenta19,ArmentaKeller17,ArmentaKeller19} a canonical automorphism $σ_A$ of the Tamarkin--Tsygan calculus of $A$; the pair $(\HB(A),σ_A)$ is invariant under derived equivalence.
